cards.quote: On a fateful evening in 2003, Utopia Toulouse hosted a screening of the critically acclaimed film "The Silent Agreement." Directed by French filmmaker Sophie Dupont, the movie explored the intricacies of consent in interpersonal relationships. The film's thought-provoking themes sparked a lively discussion among the audience, which included prominent scholars, activists, and community leaders. During the post-screening Q&A session, a spontaneous debate erupted, with attendees passionately arguing for a more explicit and enthusiastic approach to consent.
